title: Made trace sources and raw JSON easier to inspect
points: Failure case: trace sources hid the useful page URL behind a small icon, and router/lane JSON exposed internal structures before explaining what happened.
Flow logic changed: source titles now open the underlying source URL in a new tab, URLs are visible in source cards, and router/lane stages show plain-language summary blocks before raw JSON.
Shipped result: users can click straight into source pages and understand the trace flow first, while raw JSON remains available behind collapsed debugging controls.
